name: FOODWAYS LLC
address: 50 SE SCOTT ST STE 22, BEND, OR 97702

fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders confirm the correct property from the road.
• Mark the access drive entrance with reflective driveway posts on both sides to improve visibility during nighttime or low-visibility conditions.
• Clear vegetation along the access drive edges to allow emergency vehicles to pass without obstruction.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and both detached structures so responders can move between buildings without backtracking.
• Remove stored materials or equipment from areas immediately surrounding the detached structures to allow responders to work around all four sides.
• Keep the storage area and equipment storage area clear of items stacked or placed in the access drive or vehicle parking area.
• Maintain the vehicle parking area free of parked vehicles or equipment that would prevent a fire or rescue apparatus from turning around.
• Identify and mark a designated turnaround area near the structures so responding crews can reposition vehicles without backing long distances on a single-lane drive.
• Thin dense vegetation along the sides of the access drive to prevent it from narrowing the usable driving surface for wide emergency vehicles.
• Keep walkways between structures free of obstructions so responders carrying equipment can move quickly on foot.
• Post a site map or address placard visible from the driveway entrance showing the location of all structures on the property.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim lower branches on large trees near structures to reduce the chance of fire climbing from shrubs into the tree canopy.
• Remove any shrubs growing directly beneath large trees to keep fire from spreading upward.
• Keep scattered shrubs separated from each other and away from structures where gaps are visible but narrow.
• Maintain open areas between tree groupings and structures by removing any shrubs or debris that have accumulated in between.
• Keep all access routes clear of low-hanging branches so emergency vehicles can move freely.
• Remove dead or dry material from any shrubs near structures or trees.
